name: Cloud Edge Channel
description: Edge-side channel for ClawHub. The edge QwenPaw registers, heartbeats, polls tasks, executes locally, and reports results through outbound HTTP.

config_fields.name: hub_url
config_fields.description: ClawHub base URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080.

config_fields.name: username
config_fields.description: Operator or server username displayed in ClawHub.

config_fields.name: token
config_fields.description: Optional shared secret sent as X-Edge-Token.
